import { Meta } from '@storybook/addon-docs/blocks'; # Accessibility The UBS Design System complies with **WCAG 2.2 Level AA**. Every component is built with accessibility as a first-class concern. This page documents the guidelines, contrast requirements, and rules that all UBS digital products must follow. --- ## Standard All UBS digital and print communications must meet **WCAG 2.2 Level AA**. --- ## Contrast Requirements ### Minimum Ratios | Content Type | Minimum Ratio | Applies To | |-------------|---------------|------------| | Standard text | **4.5:1** | Text smaller than 25px (or 18.7px bold) | | Large text | **3:1** | Text 25px+ (or 18.7px+ bold) | | Icons & graphics | **3:1** | Against background or adjacent colours | ### UBS Colour Contrast Matrix export const ContrastCheck = ({ fg, bg, fgName, bgName, ratio, pass }) => ( {fgName} {bgName} {ratio} {pass ? ( ✓ Pass ) : ( ✗ Fail )} );
Foreground Background Ratio AA Normal
> **Note:** RAG Amber (#E4A911) fails contrast against white backgrounds for normal text. The Alert component uses a darker background tint to ensure compliance. --- ## Interactive Contrast Demo export const ContrastDemo = () => { const pairs = [ { fg: '#000000', bg: '#FFFFFF', label: 'Black on White' }, { fg: '#E60000', bg: '#FFFFFF', label: 'UBS Red on White' }, { fg: '#FFFFFF', bg: '#000000', label: 'White on Black' }, { fg: '#FFFFFF', bg: '#E60000', label: 'White on UBS Red' }, { fg: '#000000', bg: '#ECEBE4', label: 'Black on Pastel I' }, { fg: '#5A5D5C', bg: '#FFFFFF', label: 'Gray V on White' }, ]; return (
{pairs.map(({ fg, bg, label }) => (
{label}
Sample text Aa Bb 123
))}
); }; --- ## Accessibility Rules ### General | Rule | Requirement | |------|-------------| | **Colour independence** | Colour alone must never convey meaning. Use icons, text, or patterns. | | **Alternative text** | All non-decorative images must have meaningful alt text. | | **Heading structure** | Documents must use a logical heading hierarchy (h1 → h2 → h3). | | **Document title** | All documents must have a meaningful ``. | | **Language** | Documents must declare their language (`lang` attribute). | | **Focus indicators** | All interactive elements must show visible focus (2px minimum). | | **Touch targets** | Minimum 44px touch target size (WCAG 2.5.8). | ### Typography | Rule | Requirement | |------|-------------| | **Minimum size** | 14px (10.5pt) absolute minimum across all text | | **Recommended body** | 16px (12pt) for body text | | **Line height** | 22px (17pt) for 16px body text | | **Zoom support** | Content must work at 400% zoom without loss of functionality | | **No text in images** | Avoid placing text within images. If necessary, 4.5:1 contrast minimum. | ### Data Visualisation | Rule | Requirement | |------|-------------| | **Chart gaps** | 2px minimum gap between segments on screen when contrast < 3:1 | | **Always 2D** | No 3D charts, ever | | **Line types** | Use different line types for monochrome sequences | | **Colour + shape** | Never rely on colour alone in charts | --- ## Testing Tools UBS recommends these tools for accessibility verification: | Tool | Type | Link | |------|------|------| | **Colour Contrast Analyser** | Desktop app | Paciello Group (TPGi) | | **contrastchecker.com** | Online | [contrastchecker.com](https://contrastchecker.com) | | **axe DevTools** | Browser extension | [deque.com/axe](https://www.deque.com/axe/) | The Storybook `@storybook/addon-a11y` addon runs axe-core checks on every story. Check the "Accessibility" panel for each component. --- ## Component Compliance Every component in this library includes: - Semantic HTML elements with appropriate ARIA roles - `aria-label` / `aria-labelledby` for non-text content - `aria-live` regions for dynamic content (alerts, toasts) - Focus management for interactive components - Keyboard navigation support - Sufficient colour contrast for all states - `prefers-reduced-motion` support for animations --- ## Reporting Issues If you find an accessibility issue in any component, please raise it as a **P1 (critical)** issue. Accessibility compliance is non-negotiable for UBS brand standards.

welcome-introduction--docs.title: Welcome/Introduction
welcome-introduction--docs.content:
import { Meta } from '@storybook/addon-docs/blocks';

<Meta title="Welcome/Introduction" />

# UBS Design System

Welcome to the UBS Design System component library. This library provides a complete set of React components that strictly enforce UBS brand guidelines, ensuring consistency and compliance across all digital products.

## Overview

The UBS Design System is built with:

- **React 18** with TypeScript
- **CSS Modules** for scoped, collision-free styling
- **Vite** for fast builds and HMR
- **WCAG 2.2 Level AA** accessibility compliance

## Core Principles

### Brand Compliance
Every component enforces UBS brand rules at the code level. UBS Red is never applied to numbers. Typography follows the 16-level UBS hierarchy. Charts are always 2D with correct colour sequences.

### Accessibility First
All components meet WCAG 2.2 Level AA requirements. Minimum contrast ratios of 4.5:1 for standard text and 3:1 for large text are enforced. Colour alone is never used to convey meaning.

### Regional Awareness
Trading colours respect regional conventions. In EMEA and US markets, green indicates positive and red indicates negative values. In APAC markets, this is reversed.

## Getting Started

### Installation

```bash
npm install @ubs/design-system
```

### Basic Usage

```tsx
import { UBSThemeProvider, UBSGlobalStyles, Button, Typography } from '../index';

function App() {
  return (
    <UBSThemeProvider>
      <UBSGlobalStyles />
      <Typography variant="subheadline1">Welcome to UBS</Typography>
      <Button variant="primary">Get Started</Button>
    </UBSThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

### Theme Provider

Always wrap your application in `<UBSThemeProvider>` to enable theme context and dark mode support:

```tsx
<UBSThemeProvider defaultColourMode="system">
  <UBSGlobalStyles />
  {/* Your app */}
</UBSThemeProvider>
```

## Component Categories

| Category | Components |
|----------|-----------|
| **Components** | Button, Card, Alert, Divider, Typography, Icon |
| **Data Display** | DataViz, TradingIndicator, Badge |
| **Layout** | Grid, Impulse |
| **Brand** | Logo |

## Design Tokens

All design decisions are codified as tokens:

- **Colours**: Corporate, secondary, pastels, RAG, trading, chart sequences
- **Typography**: Frutiger font family, 16-level hierarchy, weight constraints
- **Spacing**: 4px grid scale (0, 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64, 96)
- **Breakpoints**: Mobile (320px), Tablet (768px), Desktop (1024px), Wide (1440px)

## Key Rules

1. **UBS Red (#E60000)** is for emphasis only. Never use it for numbers.
2. **Frutiger** is the corporate typeface. Arial is the mandatory fallback.
3. **No 3D charts**, gradients, or shadows in data visualisations.
4. **Donut over pie** for circular charts.
5. **2px gap** between chart segments on screen.
6. **Minimum font size** of 14px (10.5pt) for accessibility.
7. **No text shadows**, justified text, or centred text blocks.

---

Explore the sidebar to see all components, their variants, and documentation.

Breakpoints The UBS responsive system uses four breakpoints aligned to ISO-standard device categories. | Token | Width | Usage | |-------|-------|-------| | `breakpoints.mobile` | 320px | Small phones and narrow viewports | | `breakpoints.tablet` | 768px | Tablets and medium viewports | | `breakpoints.desktop` | 1024px | Desktop and laptop screens | | `breakpoints.wide` | 1440px | Wide monitors and large displays | **Media queries** (for JS usage): ```ts mediaQueries.mobile // '(min-width: 320px)' mediaQueries.tablet // '(min-width: 768px)' mediaQueries.desktop // '(min-width: 1024px)' mediaQueries.wide // '(min-width: 1440px)' ``` --- ## Layout | Token | Value | Description | |-------|-------|-------------| | `layout.maxWidth` | 1440px | Maximum content width | | `layout.columns.mobile` | 4 | Grid columns on mobile | | `layout.columns.tablet` | 8 | Grid columns on tablet | | `layout.columns.desktop` | 12 | Grid columns on desktop | | `layout.columns.wide` | 12 | Grid columns on wide | | `layout.gutter.mobile` | 16px | Side padding on mobile | | `layout.gutter.tablet` | 24px | Side padding on tablet | | `layout.gutter.desktop` | 32px | Side padding on desktop | | `layout.gutter.wide` | 48px | Side padding on wide | | `layout.columnGap.mobile` | 16px | Column gap on mobile | | `layout.columnGap.tablet` | 24px | Column gap on tablet | | `layout.columnGap.desktop` | 24px | Column gap on desktop | | `layout.columnGap.wide` | 32px | Column gap on wide | --- ## Border Radius | Token | Value | |-------|-------| | `borderRadius.none` | 0px | | `borderRadius.sm` | 2px | | `borderRadius.md` | 4px | | `borderRadius.lg` | 8px | | `borderRadius.xl` | 12px | | `borderRadius.full` | 9999px | --- ## Z-Index Scale Layered z-index values for consistent stacking. | Token | Value | Usage | |-------|-------|-------| | `zIndex.base` | 0 | Default stacking level | | `zIndex.dropdown` | 100 | Dropdowns and select menus | | `zIndex.sticky` | 200 | Sticky headers and navigation | | `zIndex.overlay` | 300 | Overlay backgrounds | | `zIndex.modal` | 400 | Modal dialogs | | `zIndex.popover` | 500 | Popovers and tooltips | | `zIndex.toast` | 600 | Toast notifications | | `zIndex.tooltip` | 700 | Top-level tooltips | --- ## Transitions | Token | Value | Usage | |-------|-------|-------| | `duration.fast` | 100ms | Micro-interactions (hover, focus) | | `duration.normal` | 200ms | Standard transitions | | `duration.slow` | 300ms | Complex animations | | `duration.slower` | 500ms | Full-page transitions | **Easing curves:** | Name | Value | Usage | |------|-------|-------| | `easing.default` | `cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)` | Standard UBS easing | | `easing.easeOut` | `cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1)` | Enter / appear | | `easing.easeIn` | `cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1)` | Exit / disappear | | `easing.impulse` | `cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)` | Spring-like impulse | --- ## Accessibility Tokens | Token | Value | Description | |-------|-------|-------------| | `accessibility.contrast.normalText` | 4.5:1 | Minimum contrast for text < 25px | | `accessibility.contrast.largeText` | 3:1 | Minimum contrast for text ≥ 25px | | `accessibility.contrast.graphics` | 3:1 | Minimum contrast for UI components | | `accessibility.largeTextThreshold` | 25px | Threshold for "large text" | | `accessibility.largeTextBoldThreshold` | 18.7px | Threshold for bold "large text" | | `accessibility.minTouchTarget` | 44px | Minimum touch target (WCAG 2.5.8) | | `accessibility.minFontSize` | 14px | Absolute minimum font size | | `accessibility.focusIndicatorWidth` | 2px | Focus ring minimum width | --- ## Usage Import tokens directly: ```tsx import { spacing, breakpoints, zIndex, transitions } from '../index'; // Use in styled components or inline styles const style = { padding: spacing.md, // 32 zIndex: zIndex.modal, // 400 transition: `all ${transitions.duration.normal} ${transitions.easing.default}`, }; ``` Or use CSS custom properties (injected by UBSThemeProvider): ```css .myComponent { padding: var(--ubs-spacing-md); z-index: var(--ubs-z-modal); transition: all var(--ubs-duration-normal) var(--ubs-easing-default); } ```

import { Meta } from '@storybook/addon-docs/blocks'; # UBS Typography System The UBS type hierarchy consists of 16 levels, all based on the Frutiger typeface (Arial fallback). This specimen sheet shows each level with its specification and sample text. export const Specimen = ({ name, spec, weight, colour, sample, style }) => (
{name} {spec} · {weight}{colour ? ` · ${colour}` : ''}
{sample}
); --- ## Font Family | Priority | Font | Usage | |----------|------|-------| | Primary | **Frutiger** | UBS corporate typeface (Monotype licence) | | Fallback | **Arial** | Mandatory replacement when Frutiger unavailable | | Mono | **Frutiger Mono** / SF Mono | Code, data tables | ## Font Weights | Name | Weight | Usage | |------|--------|-------| | Light | 300 | General body text (Frutiger 45 Light) | | Light Italic | 300i | Call-outs within body copy | | Roman | 400 | Extra-small text for legibility (Frutiger 55 Roman) | | Bold | 700 | Subheadlines, emphasis | | Light Condensed | — | Diagrams only (Frutiger 47 Light CN) | --- ## 16-Level Type Hierarchy --- ## Typography Rules | Rule | Description | |------|-------------| | No red for numbers | UBS Red must **never** be used for numbers | | No opacity | Never apply transparency to text | | No small caps | Small caps are not permitted | | No justification | Always left-aligned (RTL: right-aligned) | | No right alignment | Except for RTL scripts | | No text shadows | Drop shadows are prohibited | | No centred blocks | Centred text blocks are not allowed | | No mixed sizes | Never mix font sizes within one sentence | | No text wrapping | Text must not wrap around objects | | No red highlighting | Red highlighting in messages is no longer permitted | ## Web-Optimised Sizes | Metric | Value | |--------|-------| | Minimum font size | 14px (10.5pt) | | Recommended body | 16px (12pt) | | Body line height | 22px (17pt) | | Large text threshold | 25px (18pt) for WCAG contrast |
